fields.statement: Detached checkout at 81a527fed, run under a capped systemd scope with RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset. Re-ran the Checks block: go test -p 2 -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^Test(NewCtx|CtxFromEnv|TUI|RunWorkingDir)' exit 0 (TestRunWorkingDir, TestCtxFromEnv, TestNewCtxHome, TestTUIAppHeaders, TestTUISettingsScopes pass); -run 'TestScripts/tui-' exit 0 (all 7 tui- scripts pass); go vet ./cmd/rhiza exit 0; -skip 'TestScripts|Budget' exit 0; rhiza ship generate and rhiza render exit 0 with a clean tree. TestRunWorkingDir chdirs outside any root, runs init/status/show against a scratch repo through run()'s wd, checks errors land in the given stderr buffer, and checks a missing wd exits 1 with 'working directory'. Diff read: no os.Getwd, os.Args[0], os.Chdir or os.Executable left on run()'s path (only in main() and selfPath, which main calls); ctx.Stderr, Terminal and Rex use run()'s stderr; the TUI apps keep their folder in an atomic pointer and pass the switcher a Chdir that moves it; openModal takes exe and cwd. Env handling, flags and output are unchanged. The only os.Stderr left is startProgram's terminal handover, which the statement does not cover. A built binary run from a deleted cwd exits 1 with 'working directory: unknown'.
